info.title: PesaGuard API
info.description: Tenant-scoped transaction, reconciliation, fraud, and authentication API. This file is the authoritative HTTP contract.

x-api-contract-version.migration: /api/v1 remains stable; add /api/v2 for breaking changes.

x-api-versioning.breaking_change_policy: Introduce a new major version and retain supported prior versions.

post.summary: Create or idempotently accept a transaction
Queue an idempotent bounded reconciliation backfill
post.description: Backfills reconcile already-ingested records in a UTC half-open time window; they do not retrieve missing provider history. Windows are limited to 366 days.
Retry requires remaining retry budget, a reason, and explicit confirmation that replay is idempotent. Skip records an audited operator decision.

post.summary: Request a reasoned tenant dead-letter replay
post.description: Replay is bounded to three attempts. Stale leases require operator inspection. A queued result is not proof of completed financial processing.
